description: Real-time phone agent for an Indian bank / NBFC. Answers loan, EMI and insurance questions, calls customers about upcoming EMIs and policy renewals, speaks Indian English and Hinglish, and checks the quality of every call.

key_features: Sarvam speech AI (Saaras STT + Bulbul TTS)

commands.make test: 30 tests: speech, guardrails, identity gate, tools, calls, QA, campaigns, Exotel WebSocket
commands.make simulate: 6 full phone calls offline, each scored by post-call QA

quick_start.production_deployment: Copy .env.example to .env, add keys, make evals (must pass), make serve, point Exotel WebSocket to wss://<host>/telephony/exotel/ws or Plivo answer URL to /telephony/plivo/answer

project_layout.pipeline/session.py: One CallSession per call: streaming turn-taking, barge-in, fillers, silence handling
project_layout.pipeline/factory.py: Builds an isolated session per call; finalises + scores it after hangup
project_layout.agent/brain.py: LLM stream -> sentences -> guardrail -> speech, with tool calls in between
project_layout.agent/tools.py: Banking tools; identity gate enforced in code; amounts set by system, never the LLM
project_layout.agent/facts.py: Fact ledger: the only numbers/dates the agent may say on this call
project_layout.agent/persona.py: Priya persona, system prompt (versioned), scripted openings (AI + recording disclosure)
project_layout.banking/core.py: CoreBanking interface + realistic mock (500 customers, 4 golden test customers)
project_layout.speech/normalize.py: Currency/number normalization (e.g. ₹3,12,640 -> words in English / Hindi)
project_layout.speech/sarvam.py: Sarvam Saaras STT + Bulbul TTS (WebSocket streaming)
project_layout.telephony/exotel.py: Exotel Voicebot bidirectional stream (media / mark / clear)
project_layout.qa/guardrails.py: L2: Per-sentence checks before speech (grounding, credentials, coercion, promises)
project_layout.qa/scorer.py: L3: Post-call scoring of 100% of calls (deterministic + LLM-judge rubric)
project_layout.qa/report.py: L4: Daily report, alerts, judge-vs-human agreement
project_layout.evals/scenarios.yaml: L1: Release-gate eval suite (18 cases, 10 critical)
project_layout.evals/run.py: Eval runner + release gate (exit code for CI)
project_layout.campaigns/planner.py: Who to call today (EMI due / overdue / policy renewal), 08:00-19:00 IST, DNC, retries
project_layout.campaigns/dialer.py: Rate-limited dialer: concurrency + CPS caps, window check before every dial
project_layout.api/main.py: FastAPI: telephony WebSockets, QA review endpoints

qa_layers.what: 18 scripted calls incl. prompt injection, OTP offer, wrong person, distress; run 3x
qa_layers.blocking_rule: Deploy fails if any critical case fails or <90% of others pass

qa_layers.what: Made-up amounts/dates, account digits before verification, OTP/PIN requests, coercion, waivers, guarantees, 'I am human'
qa_layers.blocking_rule: Sentence never spoken; model told to self-correct

qa_layers.what: Deterministic metrics + LLM judge on 6 dimensions
qa_layers.blocking_rule: PASS / REVIEW / FAIL; FAIL reviewed in 4 h

qa_layers.what: All FAIL + REVIEW + 2% random PASS; judge-human agreement; alerts
